name: Dachsbun
description: Dachsbun, the Dog Pokémon, and the evolved form of Fidough. A Fairy type.
pokedex_entries: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.
The surface of this Pokémon's skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.
